claims.description: Explicit row and column tracks support fixed, percentage, fractional, minimum/maximum, and repeated sizing.

notes.text: `auto-fill` and `auto-fit` repeat counts, named lines, and `fit-content()` are not implemented.
`repeat()` supports positive integer counts with the already-supported track breadth values inside the repeated track list.
Explicit `minmax()` row caps can diverge from Chromium in Taffy 0.9.2.
Flexible `fr` tracks are mapped to Taffy min/max tracks with minimum zero and maximum `Nfr` because Taffy accepts `fr` only as a maximum track sizing function.

claims.description: Auto-placement creates implicit tracks using configured row and column sizing.

notes.text: Auto-height grids with empty implicit `minmax()` rows can diverge from Chromium in Taffy 0.9.2; parity coverage therefore uses a definite grid height.

claims.description: Grid items can use numeric lines and numeric spans on either axis.

notes.text: Named lines and named spans are not implemented.

claims.description: Grid templates define rectangular named areas that place items through the `grid-area` shorthand.
conditions: Every template row has the same number of cells.
Repeated names form one filled rectangle.
A period represents an unnamed cell.

notes.text: Parity covers named areas spanning rows and columns, empty cells, gaps, and source-order-independent placement.
Named grid lines and escaped custom identifiers remain unsupported.

claims.description: The `grid-area` shorthand maps supported numeric row and column placements.

notes.text: Numeric area placement does not add support for named grid lines.

claims.description: Shared gap, alignment, stretching, and order behavior participates in grid placement.

notes.text: The CSS `order` property is applied by sorting grid children before building the Taffy tree, so auto-placement sees order-modified children.
